ranking_note: Authored from the before description at commit 408a7cc654e34d620ebd557b2d6943448a4365a1, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are skill-quality:check (lints a skill: frontmatter, caps, evals.json and the shared listing budget), harness-ops:prerequisites (a fleet-wide report of the external tools every enabled plugin declares), toolchain:check-prerequisites (the same tool check for the toolchain plugin's build and lint tools), instruction-placement:check-prerequisites (the same tool check for the instruction-placement plugin), markdown-format:check (whether markdownlint-cli2 and node resolve for the markdown hook) and evals:validate (static validation of a plugin eval suite before a run). check-prerequisites owns a read-only report of whether the external tools the skill-quality plugin itself declares resolve on this machine, installing nothing.
